name: A Letter For You!
source:
You play as Alex, a lonely vampire girl moving into a new town!.. Full of other monster girls, of course. She's working as a mail delivery girl, and the yearly Blossom Festival is only a week away! Will she find someone to go with in time?

[From [url=https://walkbout.itch.io/aletterforyou]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演亚历克斯，一个刚搬到新镇上的孤独吸血鬼女孩！当然，这里住满了其他魔物娘。她在镇上担任邮递员，而距离一年一度的花开节只剩一周。她能及时找到一起参加节日活动的伙伴吗？

[摘自[url=https://walkbout.itch.io/aletterforyou]itch.io[/url]]
